title: Co-founded the Hope Group with three siblings in 1982
statement: Co-founded the Hope Group with three siblings in 1982, starting with quail and chicken hatching, then agreed to split the group into four separate sibling-led companies in 1995, retaining and building East Hope Group.
outcome: East Hope Group grew into a major diversified enterprise spanning agribusiness, chemicals, and non-ferrous metals, with Liu Yongxing continuing as its founder, chairman and CEO.
